applies_why: The judge text rules on a collision between the challenger's chain answer and the defender's chain answer over Matthew 1:20, so K-C governs that collision.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the phrase 'by footing': whether merely naming each side's answer counts as weighing by footing, or whether K-C requires comparing the support each chain gives; the text supplies no such comparison.
why: Because the judge text declares the collision underdetermined merely from the existence of two answers and does not state or apply a chain-against-chain footing comparison, it leaves undone what K-C requires.
